title: DFW Boat Charters and Rentals - Joe Pool Lake
specs: Year-round operation including winter with special safety protocols
Captains trained for cold-weather navigation and safety
Boats include luxury yachts, pontoons with water slides, party barges, and double-deckers
Children 13 and under must wear life vests at all times per Texas law
Must request wakeboard and/or tubes for watersport boats at booking for a small fee
Weight limits apply per boat; excessive weight or coolers may cause trip cancellation
No glass allowed; aluminum cans or plastic only
Yachts hold up to 20 persons; tritoons 12 persons; ski boats 8 persons; double deckers 16 persons
Private groups and corporate outings available

blurb: Guests rent various boats with experienced captains for leisure, celebrations, and watersports on Lake Lewisville. Boats include luxury yachts, pontoons, double-decker party boats, and ski boats. Safety gear and life vests are provided, and captains handle navigation and safety protocols.
extraNote: Strict 3 week cancellation policy: no refunds within 3 weeks of trip · 5% cancellation fee for credit card paid deposits; no fee for Zelle deposits · Trips cancelled for storms (thunder/lightning/heavy rain) will be rescheduled within same summer, no refunds · No cancellations for overcast or light rain; final weather decisions made up to 2-3 hours before trip · If storm begins during trip, refund for unused portion · $150 cleaning fee and trip termination if vomiting due to alcohol occurs, no refund · Pick up location for each boat will be sent within the rental confirmation email. · Year-round operation with special notes for winter and summer seasons.
